explanation.headline: Pregabalin is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; three hospital sites hold 18.7 to 43 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include pregabalin as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 675 capsules of the 300 mg presentation at 15.7 per day, providing 43 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 489 capsules at 18.6 per day, providing 26.2 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 89 capsules at 4.8 per day, providing 18.7 days on hand.
A labeled product from Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) was last inspected on 2026-07-16 and classified VAI.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
